summary: Reviewed unit RRU-c25594e8a626 (773 Lean files, LeanPool/@subtrees/5 of Vilin97__lean-pool), which grew from 528 previously retained files. The scope spans BannaiBannaiStanton, Champernowne, Chvatal, Erdos132ConvexK3, Erdos137, EuclideanJordan (with vendored HermitianMat/Commutes tactic code), ExpChaotic, FelConjecture, Incompleteness (Foundation/Arithmetization), InflationTermination, Isoperimetric, Lean4GlCoalgebras, LeanModelChecking, LocalComplexGeometry, MetricCodes, MisereGames, Monlib4, OSforGFF, PentagonalNumberTheoremAnalytic, QuadraticIterates, RellichKondrachov and SardMoreira. Every one of these files was read. They are module-index aggregators (Monlib4, OSforGFF, Incompleteness, InflationTermination, PentagonalNumberTheoremAnalytic, RellichKondrachov L2CompactnessCriterion, Erdos137/AxiomAudit), two `declare_aesop_rule_sets` files, and one namespace/variable-only file. Under FILTER-007 the pure aggregators stay primary-eligible, because the FD-016 navigation-import-only ranking role handles them and this review cannot verify an auxiliary delivery path. Sibling units of this source retained the same class. The rule-set and namespace/variable files contain formal commands, which puts them outside the FILTER-007 unilateral class. The remaining files hold real definitions and proofs. Default disposition: retain all 773 files, no exclusions.

summary: Inspected all 11 changed/added files. Every file contains substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, theorems, lemmas, instances, structures, and proofs — across various domains: Hermitian matrix algebra, isometries and simultaneous diagonalization, Fel's Conjecture for numerical semigroups, Hilbert-style logic systems, cycle graph Fourier analysis and inflation termination, local complex geometry and Nullstellensatz commutative algebra, metric code foundations and projection certificates, universal root complexes and BGG complexes, minimal projections in Hilbert spaces, quadratic iterate Galois theory, and Möbius factor integrality in UFDs.
